comment: What a Dungeon Totem from DT's loot or an evoker is: one totem picked by these weights (editor/RandomTotemTable). The Void Totem is left out of the roll until the train reaches the first End band (editor/VoidTotemGate). Trade values follow these weights: the lowest weight is worth a quarter of a vanilla Totem of Undying, heavier ones proportionally less (compat/TradeEverythingBridge). Ids that are not registered are skipped.
